description: Read the full open-data record of one directory church you already have an id for (lb:church:<country>/<slug>), live from the Christian Knowledge API: name, denomination, country, website, sameAs links, provenance, and the details the church verified itself when it has. Use after find_churches_near, search or ask_living_bread returned an lb:church id. Not for finding churches by place (find_churches_near); for any other lb: URN use kingdom_protocol_lookup. An unknown country/slug returns a not_found error pointing to find_churches_near. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

country.description: Country slug (the part after "lb:church:" and before "/"): "united-states", "colombia". A plain country name is slugified.

slug.description: Church slug (the part after "/"), e.g. "iglesia-la-capuchina". A full lb:church:<country>/<slug> id is also accepted.

name: church

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

provenance.description: Where each part of the record came from (e.g. OpenStreetMap, Wikidata).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

verified.description: Details the church supplied and verified itself; absent when it has not.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

website.description: The church's own website, when known.

title: One church, as open data
